name: UUID / GUID
description: Detects RFC 4122 Universally Unique Identifiers (UUIDs / GUIDs). UUIDs are frequently used as primary keys, session IDs, and user identifiers. Under GDPR, a UUID that consistently identifies a user or session is personal data. Matches versions 1-8 with the IETF variant bits.

metadata.versions: v1 through v8 (version nibble constrained to 1-8)
metadata.note: Version nibble [1-8] and variant bits [89aAbB] keep this tight; UUIDv0 and non-IETF-variant UUIDs are not matched.

effect.message: UUID/GUID redacted (potential user or session identifier)
